entries.title: Alpha only: knowledge keeps what you save
entries.body: In alpha builds, knowledge keeps what you tell Firstmate about yourself, and an article or other source you ask to save. A crewmate reads that source, keeps its link and a short excerpt, and fits it in with what you already saved. How a project works stays in the project. Stable releases do not have knowledge.
entries.noPicture: The change is what gets saved when you ask, not a new screen.
